```{r}

```

CUMULATE 
```{r}
draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)
# Create cumulative sums by i, ordered by event_time
# cumulative within unit
fits[, c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, cumsum)
     , by = .(dgp, nc, model, r, i)
     , .SDcols = c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]
```
     

```{r}
dim(fits)
nbins <- 25

model_colors <- c(
  "TWFE"    = "#1b9e77",
  "ETWFE"   = "#66c2a5",
  "RW"      = "#a6cee3",
  "RW-IID"  = "#1f78b4",
  "RW-ST"   = "#08306b",
  "GB-Ens"  = "#e69f00"
)

fits[, rmse_q := (cut(rmse_pre
    , breaks = quantile(rmse_pre, probs = seq(0, 1, 1 / nbins), na.rm = TRUE)
    , include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE
  ) / nbins * 100) |> round() |> as.integer()
  , by = .(dgp, nc, model, s)
]

fits[, sq_diff := (y - y0_hat) ^2]

pfp_dt <- fits[, .(rmse = sqrt(mean(sq_diff)))
               , by = .(dgp, nc, model, s, rmse_q, r)] [, .(
  rmse = mean(rmse)
  , rmse_lower = quantile(rmse, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  , rmse_upper = quantile(rmse, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(dgp, nc, model, s, rmse_q)]

dim(pfp_dt)
100 * 6 * 5 * 2 * 3

summary(pfp_dt$rmse)
summary(pfp_dt$rmse_upper)
summary(pfp_dt$rmse_lower)
setkey(pfp_dt, nc, dgp, s, rmse_q, model)
pfp_dt[model == "TWFE" & s == 4 & nc == "NonCore" & dgp == "MAR", ]


library(mgcv)
dt <- pfp_dt[model == "TWFE" & s == 4 & nc == "NonCore" & dgp == "Latent level"]
fit <- gam(rmse ~ s(rmse_q), data = dt)
pred <- predict(fit, type = "response")
slope <- diff(pred)
slope2 <- diff(slope)
knee <- which.max(slope2)
dt[as.numeric(names(knee)), .(rmse_q)]

```

```{r}
pfp <- pfp_dt[s == 4 & nc == "NonCore"] |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rmse_q  #|> factor()
    , y = rmse, ymin = rmse_lower, ymax = rmse_upper, col = model, fill = model
  )) +
  #geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(dgp ~ .) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Pre-period RMSE percentile", y = "Post-period RMSE") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    , legend.position = "bottom",
  )

pfp

png(paste0("output/pre_fit_plot.png")
  , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 3, res = 300
)
pfp
dev.off()
```
